text:
Situation: Amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium was on FDA's shortage list from 2022-10-28 and is now resolved as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 19.2 days of the 200 mg/5 mL + 28.5 mg/5 mL 100 mL presentation. Corvale General holds 27.3 days of that presentation and 26 days of the 400 mg/5 mL 50 mL presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage history shows the product was first posted on 2022-10-28 and resolved on 2026-10-21. An FDA inspection of NuCare Pharmaceuticals Inc. (FEI 3003294404) ended 2020-01-10, classified VAI, with classification letter dated 2020-02-26 — 1022 days before the shortage posting. NuCare received a Warning Letter on 2019-09-27 and prior VAI inspections in 2010, 2015, and 2018. Asclemed USA Inc. (FEI 3001452204) had an OAI inspection ending 2018-09-27 and a Warning Letter on 2019-06-11.

Our position: Current inventory is limited at Corvale East. The rule-based best option is Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and operates plants in Jordan (2INAMOXU24N-E and 2INAMOXU12N). Sandoz Inc., Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Chartwell RX LLC, and Devatis Inc. are also not on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Sandoz Inc. as secondary source — requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as tertiary source — requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Chartwell RX LLC and Devatis Inc. for future qualification — requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
